phone.name: Android Phone
phone.noteAr: عباداتي اختياري: قرآن وأذكار وتسبيح محفوظ محليًا، مواقيت الصلاة وتنبيهات وأذان في الخلفية. مواعيد المباريات داخل IPTV.
phone.noteEn: Optional My Worship: offline Quran, adhkar, tasbih and local prayer times, background reminders and Adhan. Match schedules inside IPTV.

changes: TV search uses the internal QWERTY/Arabic keyboard with a visible delete-character key; Back dismisses trailer and restores the existing IPTV page.
Loading enters Home when the first usable content arrives and never traps the viewer behind a stalled provider; remaining sections continue in the background.
Player category menus scroll correctly, open the current channel category and retain focus. Plus identity has an app-private upgrade backup; transient verification failures do not change paid themes.
Android provider compatibility restores the older HTTP client profile after404 only; real Hydra-account verification remains pending.
Standalone Samsung/LG packages now include the shared player stylesheet: visible controls, usable settings and remote focus retained during asynchronous metadata.
Prayer city search opens its native input on first activation and preserves accented city names; the geocoder returns up to20 localized results.
Matches: on-demand free statistics, partial available lineups and events; three requests per opened match, cached10minutes, and Back restores the selected match.

Matches: Previous, Today, Tomorrow, Next 7 days and choose a day; local timezone and cached filtering without network requests on navigation. Today home summary and one translucent prayer/match panel, with independent accessible actions.
Updated every Samsung WGT install guide and download link to the current release.
Fixed the shared Launcher backdrop pushing Apps, Inputs and Settings offscreen. Radio search opens the keyboard only on OK; all visible controls and the themed mini-player are reachable.
Centred horizontal HDMI cards, shared free match schedules/results with badges and multiple favorite teams, and focus-only translucent navigation.
Delete a single saved IPTV account without affecting other subscriptions; expired accounts can be removed offline.
Category order: OK saves immediately from any row; Back cancels.
Standalone IPTV reuses the Launcher prayer page/settings and native Adhan interruption/resume. Floating prayer and match summaries have independent Home visibility settings.
Shared Plus PIN locks, viewing timers, local hiding/restoring and category ordering; two personal accounts remain free, built-in free channels excluded from the count.
Small gold entitlement locks disappear after activation; complete Plus benefits list.
Multiple favorite teams rotate in the Home match summary, with scores, competition and date.
Desktop r4: centered playback controls, no redundant information shortcut, account marker and developer credit.
validation: Android native account persistence / real D-pad / IME / player instrumentation
Samsung and LG transport/player regression fixtures
Launcher 1GB / 2-core / CPU x4 simulation; no active blur or reflections
sharedSourceReceipt: current canonical source verified across the embedded and standalone TV matrix
